messages:
clara: quick idea — can we auto-assign an enablement owner when a trial account crosses the activation threshold but has no playbook or owner?
ben: curious — what exactly do you mean by activation threshold here? monthly active users? feature events?
nina: for context, our current cohort uses 3 signals: 1) 3 unique feature events in 7d, 2) first API call completed, 3) onboarding checklist >= 50%. sql to find candidates:
```
SELECT account_id FROM trial_metrics
WHERE feature_event_count_7d >= 3
AND api_calls > 0
AND onboarding_percent >= 50
AND playbook_id IS NULL
```
clara: thanks nina — yes that's the rule i had in mind. then auto-assign a pool of enablement owners (round-robin) and trigger a short welcome playbook with a single nudge. no manual triage required.
jorge: implementation notes: we should run this as a dry-run for 2 weeks first. automation should set a temporary tag "auto-enablement-candidate" instead of full assignment, then ops can approve. also rate-limit to 50 assigns/day to avoid sudden churn.
ben: +1 to dry-run. also need an opt-out flag per customer and a way to prefer existing AE ownership if present.
nina: we can surface a small dashboard: daily candidates, assigned vs opted-out, and a quality sample (10 random accounts) for review. i can add a webhook to the playbook event stream for feedback capture.
ops-bot: DRY-RUN REPORT: 42 candidates identified in last 24h, 32 have no AE, 10 already opted out. Link: https://internal/redwood/cs/auto-enablement/dryrun-1876412300
jorge: technical details — CRM update payload: minimal fields (account_id, owner_id, origin=auto_enablement, note=rule_v1). safe-retry on 409/429, and write an audit row to our cs_ops table.
clara: can we also tag these accounts with renewal-risk=low by default? they just activated so short-term renewal risk is lower, and that helps prioritization queues.
ben: fine but make that a separate toggle. we don't want a blanket label until we validate.
clara: agreed — toggle off for dry-run. once 2-week review ok, flip toggles: assign owners + trigger playbook + enable renewal tag.
nina: i'll schedule the dashboard and add sampling checks. will post results in #customer-success next Friday.
ben: thanks team — next steps: jorge to wire up the dry-run job, nina dashboard, clara to write runbook and opt-out flow. ping me once the dry-run link populates. :thumbsup:
